Executive Summary

A full office floor in Sky Tower, Al Reem Island, under off-market negotiation - modelled here at AED 35.0m (AED 1,522 per sq ft; the acquisition price is a live control on the left). The floor is income producing today: the current lease is approximately AED 1.6m per year, a 4.6% gross yield on price, running to December 2027. Completion is assumed September 2026. The business plan is unchanged from the reference model: take vacant possession, complete the fit-out, and trade the floor as a premium ADGM-facing serviced office before selling on a stabilised yield.

The floor is bought subject to the existing lease. Once we take possession the intention is to negotiate an early surrender against compensation, so the fit-out can start sooner and revenue begins earlier. That negotiation is not in our sole control, so the model prices both outcomes rather than assuming one: an early surrender, at three months and at six months from completion, each carrying a compensation payment to the occupier; and the lease simply running to its contractual end in December 2027, which costs nothing but starts revenue later. The compensation assumption is a live control on the left, and it is the entire cost of the two accelerated cases.

Exit Waterfall - Applied to Net Sale Proceeds

Return of Capital LP Preferred Return Residual LP Residual GP
TierAmount (AED)% of Proceeds
Return of capital at exit is shown net of the Year 1 VAT refund (AED ) already returned to the LP; together they return the full LP capital of AED . The LP preferred return then accrues at compounded on LP capital over the full hold from completion, and is paid before any residual split. There is no GP catch-up: the balance splits straight at the ratio shown above. The preferred is applied to sale proceeds only, so operating distributions received through the hold are additional to it.
